title: Bringing Celeste to life: how we’re adapting to better honor actor performances
body:
# Bringing Celeste to life: how we're adapting to better honor actor performances

Hello Raiders,

Toledo teems with activity. Within the busy streets of our underground home, the neighborhood of Speranza continues to hold on.

We have always wanted the human stories in ARC Raiders to feel believable and immersive, since the full range of human psychology sits at the heart of both the narrative and the gameplay.

Our actors are central to achieving this, and I want to talk briefly about the work underway to better reflect their genuine performances and bring them more fully into the ARC Raiders universe, creating a richer experience for players. We're beginning with Celeste.

# Behind Celeste

By now, you've all gotten to know Celeste, the unofficial leader of Speranza. Within Embark, she's simply known as Diana.

Diana Gardner has been part of the project since ARC Raiders began, lending her voice to Celeste's lines and giving life to one of Speranza's key characters.

Yet Celeste has never truly captured the full depth of Diana's performance. The restricted range of Celeste's facial expressions has pulled players out of the experience, with animations that couldn't quite carry the weight of the stakes and stories we wanted to convey. High fidelity, dynamic facial expression is often essential for grounding the seriousness of a story, and this has been a limitation for us until now.

# Frozen Trail-er

Our trailer for Frozen Trail arrives on October 6. It marks the first time we've used full motion capture, including a more precise and detailed facial model, letting us capture expression and emotion with far greater nuance. As a result, more of Diana's performance and personality will come through on screen.

As a consequence, Celeste now resembles Diana much more closely, so she'll appear a bit different from what you've seen before. Celeste and Diana no longer exist behind a fictional face, they have become one and the same. What you'll see is the genuine performance of a highly skilled actor, with the real Celeste appearing on screen for the first time.

# Plans for Speranza

Our cinematic trailers are just the beginning. We also want Celeste to align more closely with Diana inside the game itself. Once Frozen Trail launches, you'll see that Celeste resembles Diana more closely there too, with her actual voice and face matching for the first time. This is only a starting point, and we'll keep refining our technology over time to deepen player immersion.

Looking ahead, we intend to bring additional characters closer in line with the actors who portray them. This won't only produce more accurate representations of our actors, it will also be something players notice and feel. The Rust Belt is immersive, grounded, and full of wonder, but we want players to feel truly invested in it, which means finding more ways to weave genuine human performance into every interaction.

We look forward to seeing you all on the Frozen Trail!

All the best,

Stefan Strandberg

Chief Creative Officer
